name: Renfield

crownPassive.name: The master's servant
crownPassive.text: You keep the Fate token all fight. If both crowns are Renfield, this cancels out and the token changes hands each round as normal.

bond.name: Gothic kin
bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Gothic hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: The master is at hand
actions.text: He gains +2 Guard this round and takes the next hit aimed at your crown.

actions.name: Betrayal
actions.text: Deal 6 damage to the enemy crown, ignoring Guard and the pyramid. Then his Guard drops to 0 and his Health to 1.

rules: If Betrayal kills the enemy crown and an enemy card then kills Renfield in the same round while he is your crown, both crowns are down and the fight is a draw. Otherwise you win.
notes: A glass cannon. Betrayal is almost never used from the crown.
